name: cable kneeling shoulder external rotation
description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm outward. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
